title: District Commission must record reasons for delayed disposal
description: Who: District Commission. What: must record reasons for delayed disposal in writing. Conditions: complaint is disposed of after the period so specified. Limitations: within a period of three months from the date of receipt of notice by opposite party where the complaint does not require analysis or testing of commodities; within five months if it requires analysis or testing of commodities
